- When sentiment is consistently bullish (≥0.67) over recent days, model tends to overestimate prices; apply downward bias correction, especially after sharp upward spikes.
- After multiple consecutive auction events (especially CAP3 EU), model overreacts to supply shocks, leading to overshoot; reduce forecast slope after 3+ consecutive auctions.
- If sentiment turns bearish (≤0.33) mid-period, model fails to adjust downward; apply mean reversion correction toward historical 10-day average if true outcome drops below forecast.
- Model exhibits strong lag in responding to bearish sentiment; if sentiment drops below 0.33 and true price falls, adjust forecast 2–3 days ahead to match observed decline.
- In high-event periods (≥10 events/30d), model overestimates short-term volatility; cap forecast growth rate at 0.5% per day unless sentiment is strongly bullish.
- If true outcome dips below 60% of 30d forecast mean, apply downward correction proportional to sentiment decay (e.g., 0.2x sentiment weight for bearish events).
